question: Angle subtended by a chord xy on the centre of a circle is 180 degree, If length of this chord is 36 cm, then what will be the radius of this circle?
solution:
Given:

The angle subtended by a chord xy on the centre of a circle is 180 degrees.

The length of this chord is 36 cm.

Concept used:

1. Only the diameter of a circle can subtend an angle of 180° at the centre of the circle.

2. Radius × 2 = Diameter

3. Diameter is the largest chord of any circle.

Calculation: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0cc43db6eff4570ce94b9639a18e0400550a900023903ba56542db1b6aa462d.png] 

According to the concept,

XY has to be the diameter of the circle.

Now, the radius of the circle = 36/2 = 18 cm

**∴ The radius of the circle is 18 cm.**
